title: rangeSlider tooltips overlapping when handles close to each other
body:
The tooltips become unreadable when the upper/lower handles are close to one another.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5360586/52224330-95fd0480-285c-11e9-8d44-7d9cddeaff84.png)

Would it be possible to provide a single combined tooltip when they would otherwise overlap?
Look at the second example on this page:
http://ionden.com/a/plugins/ion.rangeSlider/demo.html
